english.title: Immobilise a motor vehicle by attaching an immobilising device
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority, immobilised a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), by attaching an immobilising device to the vehicle or part of it, intending to prevent or inhibit the removal of the vehicle by a person otherwise entitled to remove it
english.legislation: Contrary to section 54(1)(a) and (5) of the Protection of Freedoms Act 2012.

english.notes:
(i) Section 54(2) of the Protection of Freedoms Act 2012 provides that the express or implied consent (whether or not legally binding) of a person otherwise entitled to remove the vehicle to the immobilisation, movement or restriction concerned is not lawful authority for the purposes of subsection (1).
(ii) Section 54(3) of the Protection of Freedoms Act 2012 states that, where the restriction of the movement of the vehicle is by means of a fixed barrier and the barrier was present (whether or not lowered into place or otherwise restricting movement) when the vehicle was parked, any express or implied consent (whether or not legally binding) of the driver of the vehicle to the restriction is, for the purposes of subsection (1), lawful authority for the restriction.
(iii) Section 54(4) of the Protection of Freedoms Act 2012 provides that a person who is entitled to remove a vehicle cannot commit an offence under this section in relation to that vehicle.
(iv) Section 54(6) of the Protection of Freedoms Act 2012 provides that in this section "motor vehicle" means a mechanically propelled vehicle or a vehicle designed or adapted for towing by a mechanically propelled vehicle.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: A fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
